notes: New text animation 'Reveal' (左から表示). It reveals the [bracketed] highlight phrase left-to-right with a smooth clip-path wipe while the rest of the caption stays fixed in place — the static words hold their final position and the highlighted phrase fills into the reserved gap (the popular Reel caption style). Author it with the existing highlight syntax, e.g. 「[とりあえず英会話|#3742f0]」で. Available on the main caption AND every extra text layer (both use the Caption component), selectable in the Animate row next to Pop / Wipe / Fade. The actual render (src/Caption.tsx) reveals only the bracketed span(s) into their reserved width via display:inline-block + clip-path; the editor preview approximates it with a whole-line left-to-right wipe, because the preview doesn't render bracket highlight colours yet (a separate enhancement). Ships index.html (editor + preview) and src/Caption.tsx (render); Remotion re-bundles src on the next batch, so the effect applies to the next render after updating.
